name: 32456 · Port St Joe, FL
findings: ZIP 32456 (Port St Joe) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32456 (Port St Joe) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32456 (Port St Joe) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
